blocks.intro: Chicago's sewers carry rain and wastewater together, and MWRD says two-thirds of an inch of rain in an hour can overwhelm them.

items.h3: A Clear Line Has More Room
items.body: When the city sewer is full, a half-blocked lateral backs up even faster.
Late winter or early spring is the best time.
We check backflow valves and [overhead sewer systems](/chicago-lincoln-park/overhead-sewer-systems) on the same visit.

blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/chicago-lincoln-park/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/chicago-lincoln-park/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/chicago-lincoln-park/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/chicago-lincoln-park/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/chicago-lincoln-park/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

steps.body: The right tool for the buildup.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance as a Budget Line
blocks.body: For a condo building, a yearly sewer cleaning is a small, predictable cost. A backup in the garden unit, a cleanup and an emergency repair are not. Boards that put scheduled rodding or jetting in the budget usually spend less over time and hear fewer complaints from owners. We can set up a visit each late winter and share the footage with the board after every visit.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Should a condo association schedule sewer maintenance?
items.preview: If the building has had backups, yes.
items.answer: If the building has had backups or root problems, yes. A yearly cleaning protects the lowest units.

items.q: When is the best time to service the line?
items.answer: Late winter or early spring, before root growth and summer storms.

items.preview: It helps, but protection does more.
items.answer: A clean line drains better, but when the city sewer is full, you need a backflow valve or an overhead sewer.

items.q: Is sewer maintenance part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: The club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits for homeowners. Ask how it applies to your line.

items.q: Can you work with our management company?
items.answer: Yes. We can schedule visits and send reports to whoever manages the building.

items.q: How much does sewer maintenance cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the service. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether the line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
